## 经济新闻日报 2026-07-08

地缘冲突与AI浪潮共同主导今日市场叙事。美国对伊朗发动新一轮打击后油价跳涨，同时中国A股科技股在算力租赁和AI服务器板块带动下V形反弹，科创50半日大涨3%。港股方面，Momenta上市首日仅涨3%反映市场分歧，而港股年内新股即将破百，但AI股票解禁潮在即带来流动性压力。欧洲市场关注ECB对AI网络威胁的警告以及欧洲股市估值洼地的讨论。

- **美伊冲突升级推高油价**：美国在霍尔木兹海峡袭击商船后对伊朗目标完成打击，并撤销伊朗石油销售授权，布伦特油价应声上涨（[Oil jumps as U.S. 'powerful strikes'](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/08/oil-prices-brent-wti-iran-us-hormuz.html)）。与此同时，中国原油需求预计即将见顶，因电动车普及和可再生能源加速（[Peak oil: China’s crude demand set to fall](https://www.scmp.com/business/commodities/article/3359696/peak-oil-chinas-crude-demand-set-fall-ev-bets-ease-hormuz-fears)），长期油价逻辑出现分歧。
- **A股科技结构性行情延续**：科创50指数上午V形回升涨3%，算力租赁、AI服务器方向集体爆发（[A股午评：科创50指数“V形回升”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5SbmVXbk5NaVAwSmYyU21aYWZRbmxhelRZMl9DUE9JTk1Vbjc3NmNYalZYb2o4dXZWYjY4Y3BLdUNlQzBKRzF3bHh6UmpGcjlhQk1SSkZDQ1RjcWdwd0E)）。这与美股科技股集中度趋同——CSI 300中科技股权重已达27%（[Mainland China markets follow US in embracing tech stock dominance](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3359788/mainland-china-markets-follow-us-embracing-tech-stock-dominance)），但需警惕港股AI解禁潮带来的卖压（[Zhipu AI, MiniMax shares to provide gut check](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3359697/zhipu-ai-minimax-shares-provide-gut-check-hong-kong-investors-lock-ups-end)）。
- **Rivian暴跌反映电动车行业资金困境**：Rivian因股票发行触发近两年最大跌幅18%，市场担忧其现金紧张（[Rivian’s stock sale triggers worst rout](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/rivians-stock-sale-triggers-worst-rout-for-the-shares-in-nearly-two-years-6791789e?mod=mw_rss_topstories)）。这与Momenta上市、澳洲港口工人要求28小时工作周以应对AI自动化形成对照（[Australia dock workers call for 28-hour week](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cd95wendvdeo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)）。
- **央行与监管动向**：美联储就反洗钱新规征求意见（[Federal Reserve Board requests comment](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260707a.htm)）；中国央行连续20个月增持黄金至2346吨（[China extends gold-buying binge to 20th month](https://www.scmp.com/business/commodities/article/3359742/china-extends-gold-buying-binge-20th-month-amid-beijings-de-dollarisation-push)）；香港扩大人民币业务设施至500亿人民币（[Hong Kong yuan facility to expand 150%](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3359730/hong-kong-yuan-facility-expand-150-us736-billion-meet-international-demand)），推动去美元化。
- **欧洲经济分化**：ECB首席经济学家Lane发表AI与货币政策演讲（[Philip R. Lane: AI and monetary policy](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/key/date/2026/html/ecb.sp260706~b81aa4e329.en.html)），同时ECB要求银行准备应对AI网络威胁（[ECB tells banks to prepare for AI-powered cyber threats](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxPZzlmd2lLQXA4SlN5WndCZ0lNYndId2ZsS2ZVVVBWdFBZdE43OWkyTEdTaVNnTkZ3UVJGOFdPRFdXdGZaRm04UVRVUlViYUhHT2dLeUNVVm9oOGcwZUZFUEY1TWsxeEVqMWdndWs3eHBmM3l1Yk1BQWNzVzItTUMtQ1VKWlMxUnNJWktMdjZ5Vl9xenBQUjNneW1ldXZSeFAxTF8xbzhVS0lPTkRKRExuLWZPVHFsQzA)）。《经济学人》称欧洲经济虽糟糕但股市估值便宜（[Europe’s economy is a mess. Its stock markets are a steal](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxNTnlTU3lwQkhQZXhPaUNveU5KZmxsTERIeU5FM2toQnFLTkJ4a0RMOW1RelZqZGtQeWR0ZV9ReldhM2dUT3UtZXcwaTlKZzlGU19neDh6Y1pWRTdNWnRDNU5pOVF5ZlMxUjBXWlNiVTRTUVhZNFpiY3VfZWNHMFBpUGNLWXB3eVM5cHFsS1VvbC1QVXJOX092RWpGdHhGMDdWWmJXUTlXOWlYc2NmalJGajQ2dlI)），但地缘风险和监管碎片化仍是隐患。
- **同花顺社区关注点**：贵金属板块在避险情绪下走强，百亿龙头5天3板（[百亿龙头“5天3板”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9RdUVuRVUxQ1RHZlBqTUpmUXFQQVpsa05mZ2xlNWpzNk1aREtVVkQybFp2Nl9uYjRXQl9iTU83SlFKb3A3MktlOHJWV3ZzQUNKUXNJMjR4dmtqeF9fR2ZnNnp3)）；蛇年18连板大牛股跌停，游资博弈剧烈（[蛇年18连板大牛股，跌停](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9vdnVUTmRvVHFLNkROZGtYSHdOME43UUMtY213VUZ6YkdwcFRycjVwYmZrVkxGUFNIRFlfaDBsalRHZVhKZExOTXVPOTlOQzFYdFlLOHlLbzdWNG11MWZ5SWpR)）。

**后续观察**：霍尔木兹海峡局势若持续紧张，油价可能突破90美元并传导至全球通胀预期，届时美联储降息窗口或进一步收窄。A股科技行情能否持续需观察周四MLF操作及北向资金动向。港股AI解禁潮的实际抛压将是检验市场承接力的试金石。欧洲央行如何平衡通胀与增长，以及美国中期选举前Mitch McConnell健康问题可能影响参议院格局，均需持续跟踪。
economy.en:
Geopolitical shocks and technology shifts drove market action in the past 24 hours. U.S. strikes on Iran sent oil prices surging and rattled global supply chains, while China's rare missile test added to regional defense spending bets. In equities, Chinese tech dominance deepened as Momenta debuted in Hong Kong, and mainland markets saw tech stocks become the largest CSI 300 sector. European central bankers warned of AI-powered cyber threats, and the ECB's Philip Lane spoke on AI and monetary policy. Meanwhile, Hong Kong expanded yuan facilities and deepened bond markets, signaling a push for de-dollarisation. The week ahead will test liquidity as AI and semiconductor lock-ups expire in Hong Kong, and as U.S.-Iran tensions evolve.

- [Oil jumps as U.S. 'powerful strikes' against Iran risk unraveling fragile Mideast truce](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/08/oil-prices-brent-wti-iran-us-hormuz.html) — CNBC
- [China's rare missile test will push wary Asia-Pacific countries to close ranks, analysts say](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/08/china-nuclear-missile-launch-test-pacific-weapons-military-defense-alliance-australia-.html) — CNBC
- [Chinese autonomous-driving firm Momenta rises 3% in Hong Kong stock debut](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/08/chinese-autonomous-driving-firm-momenta-rises-3percent-in-hong-kong-debut-.html) — CNBC
- [Mainland China markets follow US in embracing tech stock dominance](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3359788/mainland-china-markets-follow-us-embracing-tech-stock-dominance) — SCMP
- [ECB tells banks to prepare for AI-powered cyber threats](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxPZzlmd2lLQXA4SlN5WndCZ0lNYndId2ZsS2ZVVVBWdFBZdE43OWkyTEdTaVNnTkZ3UVJGOFdPRFdXdGZaRm04UVRVUlViYUhHT2dLeUNVVm9oOGcwZUZFUEY1TWsxeEVqMWdndWs3eHBmM3l1Yk1BQWNzVzItTUMtQ1VKWlMxUnNJWktMdjZ5Vl9xenBQUjNneW1ldXZSeFAxTF8xbzhVS0lPTkRKRExuLWZPVHFsQzA) — Euronews
- [Hong Kong yuan facility to expand 150% to US$73.6 billion to meet international demand](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3359730/hong-kong-yuan-facility-expand-150-us736-billion-meet-international-demand) — SCMP
- [Zhipu AI, MiniMax shares to provide gut check for Hong Kong investors as lock-ups end](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3359697/zhipu-ai-minimax-shares-provide-gut-check-hong-kong-investors-lock-ups-end) — SCMP

**Watch next:** Focus on oil price volatility as Hormuz tensions escalate, the impact of China's tech-lock-up expiry on Hong Kong liquidity, and the ECB's emerging stance on AI regulation. The interplay between de-dollarisation moves and commodity markets will be critical for portfolio positioning.

society.zh:
今日社会新闻板块呈现多线交织的紧张与混乱：**美伊冲突**骤然升级，美国对伊朗发动空袭，全球油价与地缘格局剧烈震荡；**欧洲政局**风云再起，勒庞被定罪后次日即宣布参选总统，法国极右翼韧性令人侧目；**暴力与争议**在欧美司法和治安领域持续发酵——摩纳哥爆炸案女嫌疑人死因蹊跷、加沙医生被拘留期间遭重殴、美国保守派活动家枪击案预审爆出更多细节；**自然灾害**方面，台风侵袭中国引发罕见龙卷风，多地民众被困；**韩国光州**则因一枚丢失的扎带陷入警察信誉危机。此外，**IOC松动对俄运动员禁令**、**澳大利亚躲过衰退但消费疲软**等消息，也在不同维度映射出冲突与博弈的溢出效应。

- [Nato allies announce £37bn for new missile project](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckg4e3lwzqzo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 北约盟友宣布370亿英镑新导弹计划，英国首相斯塔默将在安卡拉召集十余国讨论，背景是乌克兰防空压力与中东战火。
- [US launches strikes on Iran after tankers hit in Strait of Hormuz](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwykq59jwpvo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 美军对伊朗发动打击，声称要施加“沉重代价”，伊朗回应将“采取果断措施”，霍尔木兹海峡油轮遇袭是直接导火索，全球能源市场剧烈反应。
- [Will Le Pen rise again? French nationalist leader defiant after court's ruling](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvgdlprp1r3o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 法国上诉法院确认勒庞有罪，但数小时内她就启动了总统竞选活动，极右翼支持者情绪高涨，法国政坛进入新一轮对垒。
- ['The water just came so fast': Typhoon triggers floods and rare tornadoes in China](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c79ygnv9e93o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 台风在中国引发洪水和罕见龙卷风，村民被困且缺乏食物和援助，灾情暴露应急响应短板。
- [Missing zip tie turns Gwangju murder case into police scandal](https://www.thekoreaherald.com/...) — 韩国光州一起谋杀案中，关键物证“扎带”不翼而飞，案件演变为警察信誉丑闻，引发公众对执法透明度的质疑。
- [Lawyer says detained Gaza doctor was severely beaten in Israeli jail](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c07yy3pgrlmo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 加沙医生阿布·萨菲亚的律师称，当事人在以色列监狱被殴打到面目全非，人权组织呼吁国际调查。
- [IOC moves to allow more Russian athletes back into the Olympic games](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/07/nx-s1-5884882/ioc-moves-to-allow-more-russian-athletes-back-into-the-olympic-games) — IOC决定放宽对俄罗斯运动员的参赛限制，尽管莫斯科仍在乌克兰发动导弹袭击，此决定引发激烈争论。

**后续观察**：美伊冲突已从代理人战争走向直接军事对撞，霍尔木兹海峡安全将决定后续油价和全球通胀走向；欧洲内部，勒庞的“立即竞选”策略可能迫使中间派加速整合；而光州警察丑闻与台风灾害，则分别考验着东亚社会的制度韧性与应急治理能力。
society.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by a sharp escalation in US-Iran military confrontation following attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, alongside major NATO defense commitments and continued fallout from the Ukraine conflict. Domestically, significant political and legal developments emerged in Europe and the US, while East Asia saw diplomatic and economic alignment between Japan, South Korea, and the US. In China, severe typhoon flooding and educational initiatives dominated, and on Zhihu, community-driven narratives around IPO blockades and World Cup sentiment shaped discourse.

- **US launched strikes on Iran** after tankers were hit in the Strait of Hormuz, with Washington imposing 'heavy costs' and Tehran warning of 'decisive measures' ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwykq59jwpvo)). This confronts global oil supply routes and forces African nations to rethink security priorities ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/8/how-the-us-iran-conflict-is-reshaping-africas-geopolitical-opportunities)).
- **NATO allies announced £37 billion** for a new missile project; Prime Minister Starmer will convene leaders in Ankara ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckg4e3lwzqzo)), signaling a major defense buildup amid the Ukraine war.
- **Lawyer says detained Gaza doctor** Hussam Abu Safiya was severely beaten in an Israeli jail, leaving him unrecognizable ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c07yy3pgrlmo)), intensifying international scrutiny of detention conditions.
- **IOC moves to allow more Russian athletes** back into Olympic games despite ongoing missile strikes killing civilians in Ukraine ([NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/07/nx-s1-5884882/ioc-moves-to-allow-more-russian-athletes-back-into-the-olympic-games)), drawing sharp political backlash.
- **Typhoon triggers floods and rare tornadoes** in China, stranding villagers without food or help ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c79ygnv9e93o)), highlighting natural disaster risks alongside political priorities.
- **Japan, US, and South Korea share concerns** over China's missile launch ([Google News Japan Korea Society](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBlNjNkV21tMXlJTWN2cF9ONkxFVGVTZ296Tk9id2RIM2tmNTBJMEJja3JENmNwRXFXUVJwWXJReE5HZkhkSFhseEx5OWlQaThOcTNadC1VaHBxS1d2d1VCQ0dR)) and forge an SMR export alliance ([Aju Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE1VclB0bHMwNGRydVo2Q2M1ZzJuc2pSV0huTXNjXzdkTVpxSDZhU0t5M2NTRk9HckU5RXJ6Mk0zWXVzcm5jT0dXaS1jcndBaEZuOHhfWTBVV1dVVFnSAVdBVV95cUxOWlB5VFFTS2VxTmpNQXpLNW8xNkNndm53cU9QNVBscFhtLUtCbkhTa3ZNM3NVbkxlWm5OU05Uck10OWJpci1Dd00wU0JWYnJObkI3ZzNqSFU)), underscoring trilateral strategic alignment.
- **Marine Le Pen launches presidential campaign** hours after a court confirmed her guilty verdict ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvgdlprp1r3o)), reshaping French electoral dynamics.
- **Suspect in Charlie Kirk shooting** reportedly ate Chick-fil-A and interacted with staff before the attack, as a preliminary hearing tests evidence ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr5j983p046o)).

**Watch next:** In the coming days, look for further US-Iran retaliation and its impact on oil markets, the NATO summit decisions on defense spending and missile systems, and the aftermath of typhoon flooding in China. The IOC’s Russian athlete decision will trigger diplomatic pushback, while Le Pen’s campaign and the Charlie Kirk case will continue to polarize domestic politics. Also monitor South Korea's digital nomad visa uptake and the fallout from the Xiaohongshu IPO block on Zhihu.

military.zh:
**导语：** 今日全球军事格局剧烈震荡。美国以报复商船遭袭为由，对伊朗境内80余个目标发动大规模空袭，霍尔木兹海峡停火濒临崩溃；与此同时，中国被曝在太平洋试射极可能是“巨浪-3”的潜射洲际导弹，引发区域多国强烈抗议。两大核常兼具的军事行动同日上演，显示大国博弈已进入竞相展示“红线”的新阶段。

- **美伊冲突升级：** 美国在24小时内分两轮打击伊朗防空系统、导弹阵地等80余个目标，起因是三艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡遇袭。华盛顿邮报、PBS、Politico等多家媒体均确认行动已展开，特朗普同时在与北约领导人会晤。[[U.S. launches dozens of strikes against Iran, citing attacks on commercial ships]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxNY1o5OHkwY0twdzRvVmpHd1IyVXQyOWNObEpxcEJEaS0xSHQ2UDhRRnJ1bURnNlZKb05VWlI4SXFrRXYxZE03ZzRQV2JTTWRjN0FhZU5ZSWRPdl9CTjl5QjljS2Z2Z0hsZzBfLXB0NFpoalZPSGU2aU1zWkxUUDVETV9NcmtCb3RlZ19JUWdDbDlLeHlEWmFoZnFkNUdRV1RXSGdQN0hZTnNuRTNEWERXbTdJOVVGZw)
- **中国导弹试射震动印太：** 多家外媒报道中国在太平洋进行了一次潜射弹道导弹测试，军事专家研判极可能是“巨浪-3”洲际导弹。美国国务院发表声明批评，日本、菲律宾等国表示关切。[[要闻解说 - 中国太平洋试射导弹 区域多国强烈抗议 军事专家：极可能是巨浪-3潜射洲际导弹]](https://news.google.)
- **印太海军军备竞赛加速：** 印尼与印度签署布拉莫斯导弹采购协议；菲律宾确认从日本购买五艘“阿武隈”级驱逐舰；加拿大选择德国TKMS作为新一代潜艇（最多12艘）首选投标方。[[Indonesia Signs BrahMos Missile Deal with India]](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/indonesia-signs-brahmos-missile-deal-with-india/)
- **北约加强无人机与两栖战力：** 四国（丹、芬、德、挪）决定联合采购最多5架MQ-4C“特里同”高空长航时无人机；英荷签署24亿英镑合同建造8艘新一代两栖运输舰，专为混合无人机战争优化。[[Four NATO Allies to Procure Up to Five MQ-4C Triton HALE UAVs]](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/nato-mq-4c-triton-procurement-uav-isr/)
- **海盗活动反弹：** 非洲之角海域海盗袭击激增，分析认为胡塞武装可能支持其代理人利用红海与伊朗冲突造成的航运脆弱期恢复行动。[[Pirate Attacks Spike Off The Horn Of Africa]](https://www.twz.com/news-features/pirate-attacks-on-shipping-off-the-horn-of-africa-spike)

**后续观察：** 未来24小时需关注伊朗是否对美军空袭发动报复（可能通过胡塞或伊拉克民兵），以及中国是否就导弹试射发布正式声明。霍尔木兹海峡的停火已名存实亡，油价与航运保险费率将出现剧烈波动。
military.en:
The last 24 hours have been dominated by a dramatic escalation in the US-Iran conflict, with Washington launching over 80 strikes against Iranian targets in retaliation for attacks on three tanker ships in the Strait of Hormuz. This has shattered an already fragile ceasefire and raised the stakes for global energy security and regional stability. Meanwhile, China's test of a likely JL-3 submarine-launched ballistic missile in the Pacific has drawn sharp protests from neighboring states, while several major naval procurement deals and alliance posture shifts signal a broader realignment of Indo-Pacific and European defense architectures. Below are the top developments and their implications.

- **US strikes Iran after Strait of Hormuz tanker attacks**: The US military confirmed hitting over 80 targets, including Iranian air defense systems, in a wave of airstrikes launched on July 7-8. The strikes were retaliation for attacks on three commercial tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, which had rattled an already shaky ceasefire. ([Washington Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxNY1o5OHkwY0twdzRvVmpHd1IyVXQyOWNObEpxcEJEaS0xSHQ2UDhRRnJ1bURnNlZKb05VWlI4SXFrRXYxZE03ZzRQV2JTTWRjN0FhZU5ZSWRPdl9CTjl5QjljS2Z2Z0hsZzBfLXB0NFpoalZPSGU2aU1zWkxUUDVETV9NcmtCb3RlZ19JUWdDbDlLeHlEWmFoZnFkNUdRV1RXSGdQN0hZTnNuRTNEWERXbTdJOVVGZw), [The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/u-s-strikes-iran-in-retaliation-for-multiple-attacks-on-shipping-in-strait-of-hormuz-over-last-24-hours), [Politico](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxPUjJvZEVXRV9ja0JnUWtiQVpsaHpURVp6UzVyd01qTXF5WU5mZWdDN0hHeW03TW9ETk9zYVNGY2xkUkFUOERCWmpCQ0VTNlFxSksxNExLME1Oa25zM0NzNGhkVlNPMWM1VmpiOW9ELXdwUzE4WDg1NW5kdTBJQlNZNkhaUVlKemllN1AwS25QUkdpaVpJb1AzdVVHSnRkVWdkQVVLUFMwdXU))
- **Trump meets NATO leaders in Turkey as crisis unfolds**: The US strikes occurred while President Trump was in Turkey for a NATO summit, signaling a direct link between the alliance's agenda and the escalating Middle East crisis. ([WRAL](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxOZlFMWEFKRTRpVndVazcwMUNucjQxTVkxOEh0LXNaeFhYN09aODZBdmItdnRtNFZqckpOM3dIZmN1OGpxUzNQQnNxbGM4SnhQaksyVnk0RTF6QTNnMTVuUzFuc1dYbENxN0ZPOHlHdXRHOWFpS1ZLVi1tQldNMUsybnAtUmV5U09SMUVCZ0NYaVM4MXVzQjFBN0ZfU0lOWWpDd1E3eGVBMmo5LU1hSFNiRmY3a3FjQW5qTm54dll4OFl2bFdIdlh4b0ZrQ3Y))
- **China tests likely JL-3 SLBM in Pacific, triggering protests**: China conducted a test of what experts assess to be the JL-3 submarine-launched ballistic missile, landing in the Pacific. Multiple regional nations lodged protests, and the US State Department issued a formal criticism. ([RFI](https://news.google.), [共同网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE54Z0VyZkpEYWtyUGVBbXR2dXlwaWJ4U2haU2FlWVlrZlNyLW9aSDZ3bkFuX0N1ZUFvLWN5bnpXM0tJelk3RTAwekJnSDFzcVkwRjZrWFB1MA))
- **Philippines to acquire five Japanese Abukuma-class destroyer escorts**: In a landmark arms transfer, Manila confirmed a deal with Tokyo for five retired JMSDF destroyer escorts, marking a deepening of defense ties amid ongoing South China Sea tensions. ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/philippines-confirms-deal-to-acquire-five-japanese-abukuma-class-destroyer-escorts/))
- **Indonesia signs BrahMos missile deal with India**: During Prime Minister Modi's visit to Jakarta, Indonesia finalized the purchase of the BrahMos supersonic cruise missile system, bolstering its coastal defense and signaling closer India-Indonesia strategic alignment. ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/indonesia-signs-brahmos-missile-deal-with-india/))
- **Pirate attacks spike off Horn of Africa**: Reports indicate a surge in piracy, with suspected Houthi-backed proxies targeting shipping lanes that had only recently recovered from Red Sea conflicts. ([TWZ](https://www.twz.com/news-features/pirate-attacks-on-shipping-off-the-horn-of-africa-spike))
- **NATO moves to expand drone operator corps and energy security focus**: The alliance announced plans to quintuple the number of drone operators by end of 2027, while several members pushed for energy security to become a core NATO priority, especially in light of the Iran crisis. ([Business Insider](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxQUm1xcnRSZ1Jrb1BhVlRwcHR5UWlvU1ZCTTlMLU9FNXRGXzdQOXcwSGk5M0VZMmVMTnpfRjdKRkphT25Fc2JCYVlPNnEtNGxVbDBXMWJQU2U5RFBVSlY5dlE3WExXWVd1Y25oTkNsMFFDVDZkLXRjckxUV3BRM0lydnUxcnljdU4taG1zSm9CU09LU0phb2hCWGY1RThDb0NEWFE), [Caspianpost](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxNZERfTzVjSEw0S0dFMXlRVVlxaDN5eGJzNlZhaGQ2Y1daOVVGX3JhSXJSbk9DaVl3SjFUVEtZYjdsbTZCMGlVMFBPMmpTZ3h1cVRpTGZ6TTA4Z09QdklpTU51bUdxY0FZZmRjN0hrM2pMcXJaRjF4dFBQaWI3ZzFOc0dyRG5CeEN5Ymc))

**Watch next**: The immediate risk is further escalation in the Gulf as the US-Iran ceasefire completely unravels; monitor for Iranian retaliatory strikes and the impact on oil prices. Also track China's follow-on missile tests and regional protests, as well as the finalization of the Philippines-Japan naval transfer and the UK-Netherlands amphibious ship construction timeline.

tech.zh: 今日科技新闻呈现多线交织：AI领域，Meta以新一代图像生成模型Muse Image强势入场，却因默认抓取Instagram用户照片引发大规模隐私反弹，同时行业安全承诺出现集体退步信号；汽车板块，福特因差速器隐患召回4.2万辆Mach-E，Rivian R2上市即遭黄牛加价2万美元倒卖，折射出电动车市场供需扭曲；HackNews社区聚焦EU强制车载监控引发的隐私大讨论，以及Tenda路由器隐藏后门等安全事件；科技产品方面，Meta为平息智能眼镜隐私质疑而推出摄像头物理阻断功能，Netflix则通过聚合短内容开始向TikTok模式靠拢。以下为各子专栏详细解读。
tech.en:
**科技新闻** — July 8, 2026: A day dominated by AI privacy flashpoints, EV market shakeups, critical security disclosures, and streaming platform pivots. Meta’s Muse Image launch ignited a firestorm over the use of public Instagram photos in AI-generated images, prompting an opt-out system and a new tamper-proof privacy light for its smart glasses. Meanwhile, a wave of reports on AI safety—from think-tank warnings to an industry safety index—underscores growing unease even as Anthropic expands Claude Cowork to phones. In the auto world, ultra-low-cost EVs under $14,000 are hitting U.S. roads, while Ford and Rivian face recall and flip dramas. The Hacker News community flagged a hidden backdoor in Tenda routers and the EU’s mandate for driver-monitoring cameras, raising both security and privacy alarms. Streaming giant Netflix experiments with short-form content via publisher deals, and Microsoft layoffs gut id Software. Data center energy demand is now clashing with U.S. manufacturing ambitions.

- **Meta’s Muse Image: A Privacy Tipping Point?** — Meta launched Muse Image, accepting Instagram accounts as prompts to generate AI photos of users, triggering backlash and an opt-out mechanism. Wired and The Verge cover the fallout, while Meta simultaneously announced a privacy light tamper-detection update for its smart glasses to address modding concerns. [Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/meta-now-lets-anyone-use-your-instagram-photos-in-ai-images-unless-you-opt-out/) | [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/962485/meta-muse-image-ai-model-instagram) | [The Verge (glasses)](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/962514/meta-privacy-light-tampering-smart-glasses-update)
- **AI Safety Under the Microscope** — Global big tech retreats on AI safety pledges, warns Seoul Economic Daily and Free Malaysia Today. The AI Safety Index ranks Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI at the top while SpaceXAI gets an F. OpenAI’s chief futurist Joshua Achiam departs, and Discord admits its AI moderation system wrongfully banned users over harmless images. [Seoul Economic Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxNSXQ4Sk9MOG13MS12NkYzUHA5MTdacFgwOWRkNnVMci0xS3RJdXMtbS1MNldZVGJqMGE1YUt3WHJ4Tml3akRhU2NMMFZLSEtZRnNNUFA3aEFiX2ZzUEltTTlwWFB0TGsxejRwSVhnbVdRdTdOS1FsQjZlQVNjVlg4NDdTeWIwakg4YXhMTmhnVGtfMzlOMm82cTVrQkpSajBJMi12N3J3) | [Free Malaysia Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxNajNoc0RSaTFGZUNTY0JrWktzY1RvOHZmRnQzLVFMUUpYQ0xpcXdxTTVDcXFzbUNvcGJZQ25BeTRTYzRMeE9DR00zbXBzcGlHVXdQUWh3RENuU1ZGZjI2S2oxelZQWjZ0UlFXaGtFMi1uOE1oOVluRmluRUJPeTctaGhGa0l5dHpfYi1McDB4SXJBSEhYdXNnNzYwUDhTX1NRQk94c3U0SDNMSmUtN0RKZUtSRnhiVFZf) | [Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/openai-chief-futurist-joshua-achiam-is-leaving-the-company/) | [TechCrunch (Discord)](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/07/discord-admits-ai-moderation-bug-wrongfully-banned-users-over-harmless-images/)
- **EV Market: Cheap Rides and Growing Pains** — The Topolino, a $14,000 street-legal micro EV, goes on sale in the US, while Ford’s upcoming $30,000 electric pickup is spotted alongside an Expedition. On the flip side, Ford recalls 42,000 Mustang Mach-E for a faulty differential, and a Rivian R2 flipper tries to sell for $20K over MSRP. [Electrek (Topolino)](https://electrek.co/2026/07/07/tiny-ev-on-sale-less-than-14000/) | [Electrek (Ford pickup)](https://electrek.co/2026/07/07/fords-30000-ev-pickup-makes-full-size-suv-look-massive/) | [Electrek (Mach-E recall)](https://electrek.co/2026/07/07/ford-recalling-over-42000-mustang-mach-e-evs/) | [Electrek (R2 flip)](https://electrek.co/2026/07/07/rivian-r2-flip-80000-over-sticker/)
- **Security Alert: Tenda Backdoor and Mandatory EU Driver Cameras** — Hacker News highlights a CERT advisory revealing hidden authentication backdoors in multiple Tenda firmware versions. Separately, the EU now mandates driver-monitoring cameras in all new cars, sparking a 490-point discussion on privacy and surveillance. [CERT](https://kb.cert.org/vuls/id/213560) | [All About Cookies](https://allaboutcookies.org/eu-mandatory-distracted-driver-system)
- **Netflix Experiments with Short-Form Video** — Netflix partners with BuzzFeed, Condé Nast, and others to bring 2- to 20-minute videos to its platform starting August 3, moving beyond long-form originals. This comes as viewership for second seasons drops sharply (e.g., Beef lost 70%). [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/streaming/962528/netflix-digital-media-brands-streaming) | [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/07/netflix-dabbles-in-shorter-video-content-with-its-new-set-of-publisher-deals-with-variety-others/) | [The Verge (viewership)](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/962382/netflix-season-two-viewrship-dropoff-beef-avatar-one-piece-tiktok)
- **Microsoft Layoffs Hit id Software Hard** — Up to 50% of staff at Doom developer id Software reportedly affected, part of broader Xbox cuts. Bethesda also hit. [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/gaming/2026/07/bethesda-id-software-reportedly-hit-hard-by-microsoft-layoffs/) | [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2209928/doom-developer-id-software-is-reportedly-losing-half-its-staff/)
- **Data Center Energy Demand Threatens US Manufacturing** — Ars Technica reports that surging AI data center electricity consumption is driving up costs for Rust Belt manufacturers, undermining Trump’s “Made in America” plan. [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/07/us-manufacturers-energy-costs-soar-because-of-ai-data-center-demand/)

**Watch next:** Monitor Meta’s response to the Muse Image backlash—potential regulatory scrutiny in Europe. Also track the rollout of Anthropic’s Claude Cowork on mobile and the EU’s driver-monitoring camera mandate, which could set precedent for in-car surveillance. The Topolino and Ford’s $30K EV pickup will test the low-cost EV market in the US, while the Tenda backdoor may trigger a broader IoT security reckoning.
